articles.title: Travis Kelce expands his business empire with major new move for college athletes as questions surround his Chiefs future
articles.description: Travis Kelce is preparing for the 2026 NFL season while expanding his career beyond football. The Chiefs tight end has teamed with Publicis Group and 3 Arts Entertainment to launch Tekta, a consulting service designed to connect college athletes with NIL opportunities while offering guidance on branding, partnerships and financial literacy. The move adds to Kelce’s growing business portfolio as speculation continues over whether 2026 could be his final NFL season.

His latest tease could potentially set up another WWE storyline or renewed rivalry with Paul.
